In a recent experiment, researchers from NIST, the University of Maryland (UMD), and Qunnect demonstrated quantum entanglement transmission over a 62‑kilometer stretch of metropolitan aerial fiber. The successful distribution of entangled photon pairs across this urban network confirms that long‑distance, secure quantum communication is feasible without specialized underground infrastructure. This result represents a key milestone toward practical deployment of city‑wide quantum networks.
